falseFriends.performance: Use 'rendimiento' for OEE performance rate, not 'performance' (anglicism for show/concert)
falseFriends.station: Use 'estación de trabajo' for workstation, not 'estación' alone (train station or season)
falseFriends.rate: Use 'tasa' or 'índice' for rate in KPI context, not 'tarifa' (which means price/fee)
falseFriends.setup: Use 'preparación' or 'tiempo de preparación', not 'instalación' (software installation)
falseFriends.demand: Use 'demanda' carefully — it can also mean 'lawsuit' in legal context
falseFriends.idle: Use 'inactivo' or 'en espera', not 'ocioso' (pejorative — means lazy)
falseFriends.billion: Use 'mil millones' (10^9), not 'billón' (which means 10^12 in Spanish long scale)
falseFriends.changeover: Use 'cambio de serie' or 'cambio de producto', not bare 'cambio' (generic change/exchange)
falseFriends.yield: Use 'rendimiento de primera pasada' for first pass yield — bare 'rendimiento' overlaps with OEE performance

grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In prepositional compound phrases with 'de', the modifier noun stays SINGULAR when naming a concept/category. CORRECT: 'causas de pérdida de velocidad' (causes of loss [sg] of speed). WRONG: 'causas de pérdidas de velocidad' (causes of losses [pl]). The modifier 'pérdida' names the category of speed loss; only the head noun takes plural. Same pattern: 'razones de parada' (reasons of stop [sg]).
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Technical terms: 'la disponibilidad' (f), 'el rendimiento' (m), 'la calidad' (f), 'el OEE' (m)
grammarNotes.mexicanisms: Use Mexican vocabulary: 'computadora' (not 'ordenador'), 'ustedes' for plural you (not 'vosotros')
grammarNotes.compoundTerms: Spanish forms multi-word terms with prepositions: 'tiempo de ciclo' (cycle time), 'tiempo de paro' (stop time)
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Mexico uses CLDR es-MX format: decimal period (.), comma thousands (,). '1,234.56'. Percentage: '85.3%' (no space).
grammarNotes.capitalization: Spanish only capitalizes proper nouns and sentence-initial words. UI labels: 'Vista de turno' not 'Vista De Turno'. Acronyms remain uppercase.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE acronym is commonly used in Mexican manufacturing. Full form: 'Eficiencia General de los Equipos' (EGE), used in academic contexts only.
industryContext.regionalVariations: Mexican Spanish differs from Castilian in vocabulary and 'ustedes' usage
industryContext.leanTpmAdoption: High — Mexico's automotive industry is deeply lean-influenced (Toyota Production System via Mexican supplier networks). 4M+ vehicles/year.

commonMistakes: Using Castilian Spanish vocabulary instead of Mexican — 'ordenador' vs 'computadora', 'vosotros' vs 'ustedes'
Using 'rendimiento' and 'desempeño' interchangeably — in OEE context, use 'rendimiento' consistently (UNE-ISO 22400)
Translating 'changeover' as bare 'cambio' instead of 'cambio de serie'
Writing decimal with comma instead of period for es-MX — Mexico uses period decimal separator
Capitalizing all words in multi-word terms — Spanish does NOT use title case
Using 'performance' (anglicism) instead of 'rendimiento' — 'rendimiento' is the ISO-standardized term
Inventing Spanish acronyms for OOE/TEEP (e.g. EGO) — no UNE/ISO standard defines Spanish equivalents; keep OOE/TEEP as-is
notes: OEE is commonly used in Mexican manufacturing; formal usted. Mexican Spanish vocabulary required. P95 expansion 2.20x. Full term 'Eficiencia General de los Equipos' available for expansion.
